QuestInfo.name: [Weekly Quest] Diligent Research Reward
QuestInfo.2: You helped the Guardians of Time with their research and earned a reward.
QuestInfo.0:
Thanks to the heroes, Rona and the other Guardians of Time have gathered much information about the Vanishing Journey. They're more than grateful, so from now on, they're offering special rewards to anyone who furthers their research.
Rona can tell you more about it.
QuestInfo.1: Help the Guardians of Time with their research at least twice before midnight on Wednesday.
